title: Publishing an object_extension draft per item may skip the record-currency follow door that a published save asks
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ① product defect, measure first · Source: fleet · escalated in section ③ of the contract-review record 7013686819 on PR #35538 (card #33911). The seat ruled that a card is filed, with the grade left to triage's first touch. ⛔ Not a claim. **Read off the code, not measured, and it predates #35538.**

Grade: area:build · Bug · reach not measured → grade left to triage.

## Business reason

A published save of an `object_extension` (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/NAME`) asks the registry's record-currency follow door and refuses a record-mode amount whose `currencyField` the served object cannot satisfy (pair (a) on `main`, and pair (b) after PR #35538). An author who saves the same extension as a draft and then publishes it per item appears to get no such answer. If so, the extension becomes live with an amount that every later write refuses, which is the symptom #33911 fixes for the save door.

## What happens (read, not measured)

`promoteDraftForPublish` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`) asks the registry's follow door only for type `object`. A per-item publish of an `object_extension` draft therefore appears to reach the registry without the follow door being asked, for pair (a) and pair (b) alike.

## Expected

Every door that makes an `object_extension` body live asks the same follow door that its published save asks, and answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with the same message.

## Done when

- First step: measure at the public door. Save an `object_extension` draft that adds a record-mode amount with `currencyField: 'zz_missing'` (one segment, after #35538) and one with a master_detail-led pointer the served object cannot satisfy (pair (a)). Then publish each per item (`POST /meta/object_extension/NAME/publish`). Record whether it answers `published` and whether the first write of the amount is refused.
- If it reproduces: the per-item publish refuses both, with a pin over the publish door (status, code, message, draft not promoted) and a control showing that a satisfiable pointer still publishes, plus an ablation.

Who acts: the owner of the metadata-protocol publish path, together with the area that owns the objectql record-currency follow door.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open currencyField extension master_detail` gave only #33628 (package lifecycle verbs never ask the follow door, which is a different door) and #35562 (two-segment pointer led by a non-master_detail field, at the save door). Neither covers the draft-publish door.
